stem: Which text evidence from the selection best supports that people should be open-minded about the results if they decide to start a participatory budgeting program?

options.label: A
options.text: One participating student said the process made her feel that her “voice actually does count.” (paragraph 6)

options.label: B
options.text: The system used by most schools involves first setting up a committee of students who are recommended by their teachers and elected by their peers. (paragraph 7)

options.label: C
options.text: Additionally, some people say that giving everyone from students to administrators an equal vote devalues the education and experience of the adults traditionally responsible for creating school budgets. (paragraph 9)

options.label: D
options.text: “We don’t know what the students will come up with. It’s a point of tension, but that’s part of the process.” (paragraph 10)
